svg.aria-label: Forwarding Address — follows the wallet: the blue wallet trail leaves the red removal row and lands on an amber add row one pool over. A wallet pulled $21,330,275 out of Ring Exchange (Ethereum) UNI/WBTC; 2 min 12 s later the same wallet put 99.8% of it into UNI/WETH. The red LP-removed alert rewrites itself to an amber MIGRATION verdict.
svg.title: Forwarding Address — where the pulled liquidity went: 99.8% recovered, 2 min 12 s later, the same wallet
